_comment: What the website fetches from the map-data GitHub Release, by release-asset name, through the registry Worker's /content proxy (VITE_OH_PMTILES_URL in .env.web): the three pmtiles as /api/runtime/pmtiles/<key> maps them (<key>.pmtiles), and the editor seeds and stock regions. This is the list the signed public/content-manifest.json describes, so every entry must be the bytes the Worker serves under that name: scripts/build-content-manifest.mjs builds the manifest from it, scripts/populate-node.mjs fills content nodes from it, and server/contentManifest.test.js checks that an asset named here and in scripts/map-assets.json or mobile/map-assets.android.json has the same bytes and sha256 in all of them.
